expected_symptom: The !dx.source.defines metadata node lists each -D define more than once (four entries for two -D flags) on a command-line dxc.exe compile with -Zi; a correct compile lists each exactly once.
summary: Command-line -D defines are still duplicated: !dx.source.defines lists each define twice, exactly the node filed in 2020, on main (13730886e) and on all 20 releases from v1.4.1907 to v1.9.2607. !dx.source.args shows the -D pair appended a second time, so the duplication happens in the argument list before the preprocessor or debug info see it. Corroborated in source: dxc.cpp:881-885 passes the argv (which still holds the -D flags) and m_Opts.Defines to IDxcCompiler::Compile, and BuildArguments re-appends one -D per define (dxclibrary.cpp:506-508) -- the de-duplication that already exists for -E/-T three lines above was never extended to defines. The reported configuration dependence still holds: the TAEF harness that runs the cited test passes nullptr,0 for defines (FileCheckerTest.cpp:573-575), so the test never exercises the driver path. DXIL is unaffected; the wrong data reaches IDxcPdbUtils and the PIX/DIA surfaces.
title: User command line defines are duplicated in debug info and in preprocessor
